text_block_list.text:
"Clashing fiercely,
two souls yearning for an unseen horizon."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Haaah, haaah...! Haaah...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Red Desire! Red Desire!
Buena Vista!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...Guh,
I won't let you pass me――!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaaagh!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Is it Desire?! Or is it Buena?!

text_block_list.name: Desire & Buena
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Crossing the finish line now!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Standing at the pinnacle of the Triple Tiara's final crown, the Shuka Sho, is—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Red Desire!!
It's Red Desireーーー!!!
(WAAAAAAAH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: DESIREEE!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Huge congrats!!" "I believed in you!!"
"You were the absolute best!" "That was incredible...!!"
"Thank you for touching our hearts!!" "Our Holy Maiden!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah...!
Everyone is looking up at me—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Not anyone else, but me!
Look only at me—...!
Desire!! Desire!!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: A dazzling light tells me—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"I am truly the chosen one.
Unlike anyone else, a one-of-a-kind existence."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"The saint burdened with a special destiny,
Red Desire, you say—!"

The pouring cheers enveloped Red Desire like a veil of light,
refusing to let her go.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...It's welling up――...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...The 'other world' that I have
sought for so long is—...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Congratulations, Desire-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: That truly... was truly an incredible run...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
More than any race before...
I got so fired up... and just ran with everything I had.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Still... I couldn't catch up at all.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Buena-san...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Thank you for running with me.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for making the Triple Tiara races...
the absolute best,
unforgettable experience of my life—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Thank you so, so much!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Buena-san...
You are through and through—such a pure and beautiful soul."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
It was precisely because I had a formidable ordeal like you...
that I was able to reach this point.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
From the bottom of my heart, thank you.
To you... and to every single race we ran together!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, I don't think I've ever seen Desire-chan look so satisfied before.
A period was finally put to the long, fierce battle of the Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer!
Ah... thank you so very much...!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to your ceaseless devotion,
we were able to make it this far.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, ufufufu.
Ah... To be on cloud nine... this must truly be it...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Recognized, blessed...
and now, bringing about the conclusion with my beloved rival.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Right now... my soul is overflowing
with a radiance of joy like never before.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
If this isn't "fulfillment,"
then what else could it be...?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
The applause ringing in my head just won't stop.
That is why... I am thinking.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: "Thinking that the door to an 'otherworld' was finally opening—"
Whoa now, don't go getting satisfied on your own!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...Vodka-san...?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
That "other world" you were aiming for...
it wasn't something like this, was it?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Having a good race with a rival,
getting praised a little more than usual...
It's not a place you can reach just with that, you know.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: That is......

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If you think I gave you a hand
just to face off against Buena, you've got it wrong.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Listen up, Desire. You'll never see another world just by retracing "the scenery someone else saw."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If you wanna see another world,
you've gotta take on a challenge big enough
to smash this world's rules to pieces.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
A challenge so outrageous no one else would dare take a single step towards it...
Incredibly reckless, and the coolest thing ever!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(...That's it.
To reach an alternate world...)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"The otherworldly realm I seek could never
be a happiness continuous with everyday life."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: "Yes, an impact so soul-shaking it overturns life to its very foundations—!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"I, Red Desire...
nearly drowned in a momentary slumber."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
However... you gave me guidance.
It was just like... divine revelation――!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heh...
That's it. You can aim even higher.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Listen up, it's the Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'll be waiting at the next Japan Cup.
Defeat me, and aim for a place no one has ever seen.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
A Classic-year Japan Cup victory
by a Tiara Umamusume...—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"A realm of glory that no one
has ever reached before!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: I will go there――...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If you can run as well as that,
it'd be a total waste to quit now.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Desire. With your running...
with your "desire,"
remake this world before our very eyes!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Vodka-san...
Just how wonderful of a person are you...!

Spurred on by Vodka's encouragement,
Red Desire seemed to confront her own "desire" deeply.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Let us discipline ourselves further for the next trial.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, my apologies.
I was getting a bit ahead of myself.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Will you continue to walk beside me?
choice_data_list: Of course. Next up is the Japan Cup!
Of course. Next up is the Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Please wait for me, Vodka-san.
I swear I will surpass you
and reach heights beyond!

The conclusion of the Triple Tiara races
is merely the prologue to the next story.
"Setting her sights on the back of the one she admires as her next target, Saint Red Desire charges forward toward the Japan Cup."
